ZEN University’s “ZMC (ZEN Mathematic Center)” will announce a new project titled “LANA” on Tuesday, March 31, 2026, focusing on the computer verification by Lean of IUT theory. The announcement event will be streamed live on YouTube at the following URL:
https://www.youtube.com/live/b9ZV-4T3iUo

[Overview]
Date and Time: 2026-03-31T13:00:00+09:00 (tentative)
Speakers:
・Masato Wakayama (President, ZEN University)
・Fumiharu Kato (Professor, ZEN University / Director, ZMC) and others
Discussion at #general > LANA project announcement
